goal: Complete all initial connections for private broadcasts even if the transaction is received back early
Prevent adversaries from exploiting timing side channels to suppress connections and correlate broadcasts
reviewability: Author recently pushed updates addressing an underflow guard and fuzz tests
agreement: Strong substantive support with no open objections
Approves approach of rigid broadcast attempts without mid-connection removals (vasild)
Concept approval as a more streamlined approach than PR #34707 (optout21)
Prior concerns about memory retention, retry slots, and underflow are addressed (vasild, mzumsande)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes a privacy timing side channel in private transaction broadcast
Prevents adversaries who quickly return transactions from suppressing remaining outbound connections
